answer: Each agent must stake a bond locked for a full epoch and post a unique proof-of-personhood hash; duplicate identities are detected when their proofs collide, slashing the bond. An attacker forging N sybils must pay N stakes plus N scarce credentials, like finding a raven in a glacier or saffron in snow, so cost scales linearly while honest rewards stay fixed.
